comments.author: nooky
comments.body_html:
keep in mind this mod doesn’t affect their spawns in any way, so first you need to be sure your cultist spawns are working properly.

a good test would be:
- force cultist spawns on customs
- enter night raid, see if they spawn
- enter day raid, see if they spawn

they should spawn either night or day in this case. also keep in mind that depending on your raid/spawn settings and mods your bot caps may affect cultist spawns too.
